t: Above you is Balfron Tower, a twenty-seven-storey Brutalist block in Poplar, part of the Brownfield Estate. It was designed by Ernő Goldfinger in 1963 for the London County Council, built between 1965 and 1967, and has been listed since 1996. Goldfinger was a Hungarian-British architect and furniture designer. This was an early version of an idea he developed further in Trellick Tower in North Kensington, which looks similar. Balfron is the one to know first.
